react_native_specifics: Use StyleSheet.create for all styles. Do NOT use CSS or Tailwind classes.
Ensure all screens use SafeAreaView to avoid notches and home indicators.
Forms must be wrapped in KeyboardAvoidingView (behavior='padding' on iOS) and ScrollView.
Touch targets must be at least 44x44 points for accessibility.
Use platform-specific shadows (shadowColor/Offset/Opacity/Radius for iOS, elevation for Android).
All text must use Italian copy and maintain a warm, family-friendly tone.
Implement the 'Cloud/light-blue' aesthetic throughout the UI with rounded corners and soft shadows.
animations: Fade-in animations for screen mounting (opacity 0 -> 1 over 300ms).
Spring animations for modals and bottom sheets to make them feel playful and organic.
Pulse or gentle scaling effect on the main 'Dona' action button.
Shared element transitions for gift images from list/map to detail view.

components: Email & Password inputs with #BBDEFB border and #FFFFFF background.
Primary action button (#4A90E2 background, full width, rounded-medium).
Text links for toggling between Login and Register.
Tagline display: 'Risvegliamo il bene che è in NOI donando un SORRISO. Il segreto di vivere felici, è DONARE.'
Circular Image picker for avatar (placeholder: 👤).
Inputs for Name, City, Phone.
'Salva e Continua' primary button.

onboarding.layout: Horizontal FlatList with pagingEnabled or react-native-pager-view.
components: Large illustration per slide.
Friendly Italian title and description.
Pagination dots at the bottom.
'Non mostrare più' (Don't show again) text button.
'Inizia' (Start) button on the last slide.

home.layout: ScrollView with a header welcoming the user.
components: Header with user avatar and 'Ciao [Nome] 👋'
Three large action cards arranged vertically or in a 2x1 grid (Dona full width, Chat and Ricevi half width).
Cards should have #FFFFFF background, #BBDEFB border, and drop shadow.
Each card must feature a prominent emoji (🎁 Dona, 🗺️ Mappa/Ricevi, 💬 Chat).
Image picker section (up to 3 horizontal square slots).
Title input.
Description multiline input.
Category picker (horizontal scrolling chips with emojis: 🍎 Cibo, 👶 Vestiti bimbo, 🧸 Giochi, 📚 Libri, 🛏️ Coperte, 🎨 Disegni, ✨ Altro).
Location picker (Switch to use GPS or text input for City via Nominatim API).
Primary 'Pubblica Regalo' button.
Map with custom light styling if possible.
Blue pins (#4A90E2) for others' gifts.
Red pins (#E53935) for user's own gifts.
Bottom sheet or custom callout when tapping a pin showing mini gift card (Title, Category emoji, Distance).
map.web_fallback: A simple list view of nearby gifts since native maps don't render easily on React Native Web without extra config.

components: Image carousel (Header).
Title, Category, Distance, and Description text.
Donor info snippet (Name, Avatar).
If it's someone else's gift: 'Invia Messaggio' (Send message) CTA.
If it's own gift: 'Modifica' / 'Elimina' options.
Row: Avatar, Name, Last message preview, Timestamp.
Empty state: 'Nessuna chat attiva' with sleeping airplane illustration.

chat_detail.layout: KeyboardAvoidingView with inverted FlatList for messages.
components: Header with partner's name and back button.
Message bubbles (Blue #4A90E2 for own, White #FFFFFF with border for partner).
Input bar with text field and send icon.

onboarding.description: Illustration for onboarding slide about donating/exchanging gifts.
Illustration for onboarding slide about finding gifts on the map.
Illustration for onboarding slide about chatting.

empty_states.description: Empty box sad face - Use when there are no gifts found in the area.
Sleeping paper airplane - Use when the chat list is empty.

testing.attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `testID` attribute (the React Native equivalent of `data-testid`). Example: `testID='login-submit-button'`.
